t:
Well, I wouldn't advise you to believe the Xadaganians. This Felix is a piece of work, I've heard all about him. In fact, he is aiming for Yasker's position, and this... Ex-pe-di-tion... is a good way to win authority. And together with Catherina, they might even try and crush the League.

If what you say about talking logs is true, then they are pretty good guys. Not as good as the Orcs, of course, but still decent warriors!

I take it Skulnar is on their side? Then we need to help them! And punching Xadaganians is a good cause all around.

That's some bullshit, to be honest. Talking trees, gods, planets... If I didn't know you, I'd think that someone with a massive hangover was telling me their dream.

And Skulnar stayed there, you say?
r152695.n: Tell them what you have managed to learn in Eden

t:
There'll be time for that. Yes, and now I'm so powerful that I'll be the first to figure it out! He's not just a Great Mage, he's also Lorzub reborn...? Oh, if only my mother knew!

And, it looks like not everyone is happy that you and I are chatting. That Orc girl looks at you like... she wants to talk. You and that redhead should go...
r152701.n: There's so much I need to tell you...

t:
What does it matter now? What, you think it's something new for me? We went through so much together, I wouldn't even be surprised if you sent me to another planet! A desert is nothing...

Yes, and I know many things...
r152702.n: Skulnar! I hope we haven't disturbed you...

t: Oops, where am I... I was just training... It's you again, my friend! I'm glad to see you...
r152703.n: Oops, where am I... I was just training... It's you again, my friend!…

t:
Great!

This is what I've learned. Each stele has a riddle and three possible answers on it. Riddles are different everywhere, but the answers are the same. Apparently, each riddle has one answer...

I have translated everything, but I don't know the correct answers. Selecting an answer is simple, you just need to touch the word. It would be dangerous to pick something at random - the Junes preferred to play it safe, there are probably safety systems in place...

Ah, there's another thing. According to my research, the nearby jinns must know something about these mysteries. But I'm not dealing with them! Terrible creatures...

What else do you want to know?

Many things, youngling. Things you and I have no idea about.

What was before, will happen again. New conquerors will come, but the little scarab will continue its work! Yesterday, Nezeb walked here, today it's you, and tomorrow... who knows?

And the scarab will always be here.

The sun sees many things, youngling. It saw how the Great Mage was taken to the southern edge of the desert after a lost duel. It watched as he gathered armies, watched them set out for the north.

Many things have changed over the years, but the sun still rises over the desert. Yesterday, Nezeb walked here, today it's you, and tomorrow... who knows?

And the sun will always be here.

They seek many things, youngling. They prowled the land around the tents of the Ugra people, watched the fires from the darkness. They saw how the Great Nezeb fought for power, defeating one leader after another.

The laws of the desert are unforgiving, there is no mercy. Yesterday, Nezeb walked here, today it's you, and tomorrow... who knows?

And the animals will always be here.

Beep!

Fulfilling directive No. 5!

The artifact will be in storage until we need it. Artifact requested. Artifact given to the Creator!

Directive fulfilled. To put items back in the secret storage, use Directive No. 6!

Beep, beep! Greetings, Creator.

I'm glad you're alive. It means the Savior fulfilled his promise and protected you from Sarn's Curse.

Reporting. The world is split into pieces and inhabited by many weak Curses. New aggressive life forms detected. Wind guardians detected. WARNING! There is a risk of losing the Key of Air! WARNING! It is recommended that you put me in a combat mode and send an alarm signal to the nearest Hunter temple!

A codeword is required for this.

I repeat, a codeword is required.

I repeat, a codeword is required.
r152808.n: Beep, beep! Greetings, Creator. I'm glad you're alive. It means the…

t: We're going back to the camp. We'll officially declare Skulnar the leader and the Legendary Orc. As for you, we'll see. I'll think of something. See you near my throne, hah.

What an interesting story!

I've been thinking why Russule suddenly became such outstanding pioneer!

Well, no trouble at all. We'll just register the mechanoid as his twin brother. We just need to come up with a name. Aoidoi mentioned a very curious one... how was it? Oh, right. Electron! Let's name him Electron.

As to Alex, I was expecting him to ask me out on a date. All the while he was going through all pins and gears in devices!

I will have to improvise.
r152839.n: [Tell the story of Alex and Sergey Russule and ask for help]

t:
Troop number three is named after Mishka Kvakin, Timur's sidekick and comrade.

Unfortunately, there are pioneers that don't respect order. Yes, even here, in our beautiful camp! Comrade Dynin decided to gather the likes of them in the third troop to avoid harmful impact on others. Alice is a member of the third troop as well.

Olga Dmitrina is the leader of the third troop.

Troop number two is named after Pavel Morozin, another famous pioneer.

It's one of the biggest troops that consists of multiple smaller units. All newcomers join the second troop, including Skulnar and you. Samantha de Delice is a member of the second group. She's a goodwill ambassador, strengthening international cooperation. She represents her aunt Antoinette, who signed a friendship and au-pair agreement with Yasker. Many of our pioneers are visiting Ignis resorts and meeting people of the League.

Anton Kuznetsov is the leader of the second troop.

Troop number one is named after Timur Garain, one of the first pioneer of the era before the demonic invasion. Nezeb himself put a triangular scarf on his neck!

There's a curious tradition in the first squad: all members bear the names of legendary pioneer heroes, Suslanger defenders during the demonic invasion. They also wear their weapons and uniforms. As per usual, there are only five outstanding pioneers in this group. Now there's also Katya Rysina. She's very persistent in her studies, work, and sport achievements.

I am the leader of the first troop.
We have three troops in the camp. Which one do you want to hear about?
I don't know? I don't know?! I know everything around here! I'm a pioneer troop leader, after all. Ask the Superintendent, special objects are his responsibility.
r152844.n: You don't know anything about the Dream Factory's blueish sphere?

t: There's a neat pile of clean underwear: white socks, stockings, bows, and other girl stuff.

There's a neat pile of clean underwear: white socks, stockings, bows, and other girl stuff.

You go deeper to find a strange object and some green dust.
Contains all sorts of pioneers' things.
r152852.n: Contains all sorts of pioneers' things.

t: There's a pile of paper scraps, crayons, dried candy.

There's a pile of paper scraps, crayons, dried candy.

You keep searching to find a strange object and some green dust.
Contains all sorts of pioneers' things.
r152856.n: Contains all sorts of pioneers' things.

t: Full of pioneer uniforms. Some of them are brand new. There's also Alice's hiking suit.

Full of pioneer uniforms. Some of them are brand new. There's also Alice's hiking suit.

You go deeper to find a strange object and some green dust.
Contains all sorts of pioneers' things.
r152860.n: Contains all sorts of pioneers' things.

t: A chronophone? What chronophone? I've no idea what you're talking about. I know nothing, I've heard nothing, I've seen nothing. There's nothing to talk about.

Hah! Don't hold your breath! I don't know anything! I just went out for a stroll. So I'm... you know, strolling around, here and there. We're playing hide-and-seek. Ever heard of it? Beat it. Don't be in my way.
What? Who? Speak up! Or look for someone else. My ears are plugged, I can't hear a sound.
I can't see you, I can't hear you. Move it.
Who are you? What brought you here? Beat it. We aren't allowed to talk to strangers.

Still trying, huh? How many answers did you find? How many people did you talk to? Five? Do I get it right? Take my advice, buddy, mind your own business. There's nothing you can do about it. And take your orc with you. All he ever does is eats, eats, eats. There's no place for the likes of him in our ranks.

No one expels you formally. But you aren't one of us, either.
So you've found me, now what?
r152877.n: So you've found me, now what?

t: She took the small cabin to the right from the entrance. Opposite the Dream Factory cabin.
r152898.n: Can you tell me where Alice is staying?

t:
There are several simple rules:

A pioneer is loyal to his imperial homeland!

A pioneer takes cues from the heroes of labor.

A pioneer honors the memory of the fallen soldiers.

A pioneer is persistent in their studies, work, and sports.

A pioneer is an honest and loyal friend who always stands up for the truth.

A pioneer cherishes their pioneer badge and their group banner.

A pioneer fights for the honor of their group so they are the first in everything.

A pioneer does not let their friends down.

The pioneers are the members of the Nezeb All-Imperial Pioneer Organization! All young constructors of our country can be admitted - from high school students to university students. And after Yasker signed a truce with the League, we started an exchange program. Now any League resident of any age can visit our wonderful Dune camp to share in the spirit of camaraderie and our bright ideals.   Through this, and not through war, we're going to prove to the world that the Empire is the only true path.

To become a pioneer, you must study diligently, uphold the ideals of our country, and always be ready to help others! You must swear the pioneer oath, wear the pioneer uniform and badge!

You can repeat after me: "As I join the ranks of the Nezeb All-Imperial Pioneer Organization, I, , solemnly swear to love my motherland; to live, study, and fight as the great Nezeb instructed us!
r152901.n: How do I become a pioneer?

t: Greetings! I am Nina Krasavina, the leader of the first pioneer group! If you have any questions about our favorite pioneer camp "Dune", then I'm ready to answer them!

I'm always happy to remind my charges of these simple rules:

A pioneer is loyal to his imperial homeland!

A pioneer takes cues from the heroes of labor.

A pioneer honors the memory of the fallen soldiers.

A pioneer is persistent in their studies, work, and sports.

A pioneer is an honest and loyal friend who always stands up for the truth.

A pioneer cherishes their pioneer badge and their group banner.

A pioneer fights for the honor of their group so they are the first in everything.

A pioneer does not let their friends down.

My dear young friend!  I'm glad you asked me.

The pioneers are the members of the Nezeb All-Imperial Pioneer Organization! All young constructors of our country can be admitted - from high school students to university students. And after Yasker signed a truce with the League, we started an exchange program. Now any League resident of any age can visit our wonderful Dune camp to share in the spirit of camaraderie and our bright ideals.   Through this, and not through war, we're going to prove to the world that the Empire is the only true path.

You should know that since you're a pioneer already. But if you want, I can remind you:

To become a pioneer, you must study diligently, uphold the ideals of our country, and always be ready to help others! You must swear the pioneer oath, wear the pioneer uniform and badge!

You can repeat after me: “As I join the ranks of the Nezeb All-Imperial Pioneer Organization, I, , solemnly swear to love my motherland; to live, study, and fight as the great Nezeb instructed us!
r152906.n: How do I become a pioneer?

t: Hello! I am Nina Krasavina, the leader of the first pioneer group! I'm always happy to help, even if you are from another group. You can ask me any time.
Of course! I mean, no... Oh. I'm still working on my extrasensory abilities. And someday I'll learn to control them...
r152928.n: Well, if you have abilities, you can tell where the sphere is, right?

t: I know what you're talking about but I have no idea where it is. I suspect that the pioneer troop leader might know something. My psychic powers have never let me down.
r152929.n: Do you happen to know where the blueish sphere is? I'm trying to find it asap. The…

t: How would you know that? Has someone told you...? I specifically asked... Never mind. The thing is, I have nightmares... It's the curse of young adepts who are going to become psychics in the service of the Committee. I have rather strong powers.
r152930.n: What do you dream of at night?

t: Our group is winning the competition! We achieved great results in sports, labor, and patriotic education! We look towards our leaders as an example!
r152931.n: How are you doing as a pioneer?

t: I'm Ekaterina Rysina, the leader of the first pioneer group. I'm preparing to apply to the Higher School of Nezeb's Committee!
Who told you? Kolya Fomkin or Phima Korolkin? Don't listen to those hooligans. They are a bad influence.
r152934.n: What do you dream of at night?

t: Don't you know that our first squad is the first not only in name, but also in aspiration?   Dynin himself commended us. Do you not listen to your superiors?
r152935.n: How are you doing as a pioneer?

t: Katya Rysina. And I don't remember you. Although there are many new faces in the pioneer camp. Take Alice, for example... No one saw her, no one knows where she came from, but they decided to put her in the third group. And the third group are all hooligans! They are a bad influence. Samantha is a different matter. She's a good egg. It's hard to believe she's an elf!
Hello. Who are you and why are you loitering?
r152937.n: Hello. Who are you and why are you loitering?

t: Trust between friends is important. If you really trust Alice, you should know that we all must be extremely careful.
r152941.n: Alright. Tell Alice that I trust her.

t:
Help her? She could use help. Do I understand correctly that other pioneers are helping her, but it isn't enough?

We must persuade them day by day that peace is important. We can do so much together! The united states of the League and Empire could achieve so much together!

I'm going to tell Alice that she can count on you.

I'm sorry, she's never mentioned you.

I got to go. Sorry.
r152944.n: I'm Alice's old friend. Where is she now?

t:
Really? She mentioned that someone was threatening her. She said her enemies could get into the camp.

The thing is, not everyone is happy with the peace between the League and the Empire! Too many people can't live without war. For some, war is a way to get rich! Making their fortune on blood! How awful.

I hope you don't have anything to do with it.
A chronophone? What is that? I'm sorry, I don't know the first thing about Imperial devices.

Alice! All talks around here are about Alice!

We had a little chat, too... she's nice. And she knows a lot.

She understands my mission: development of good relationships between the League and the Empire. Alice is a passionate supporter of peace and friendship. She once told me that she did a lot to strengthen the understanding between our states. Without going into detail, of course.
r152947.n: I'd like to talk with you about Alice.

t: I am Samantha de Delice, the official elven and League ambassador in this pioneer camp! I have an honorable mission to reconcile the League and the Empire. The sole fact that I'm here is a testament to my big success.

I came to this camp to start friendship with imperial comrades. It all started with my letter to the Great Mage Yasker... after which he and Antoinette, the head of our House, decided to go with an exchange. Pioneers from the Empire were supposed to visit League allods, and we, different races of the League, were supposed to visit this amazing Duna pioneer camp!
Greetings! What a wonderful camp! Isn't it?
r152950.n: Greetings! What a wonderful camp! Isn't it?

r152960.n: All right, let's start from the beginning.

t: Even if she did, the secret of two people belongs to those two only, doesn't it?
r152961.n: Did Alice tell you to keep something?

t: You're as annoying as a bunch of hun-hurrs! Mind your own business.
r152962.n: Have you noticed that Alice was hiding something out there?

t: Don't worry, kylys. I'll ask her.
r152963.n: Make sure to ask Alice! I'll be waiting!

t: We'll be happy to keep you company. But we need to ask Alice first. You can join us if she doesn't mind. Alice promised to show me the old portal near the camp. The one that demons destroyed. Nezeb commanded to deliver its shards to another place and recreate it next to the garbage field.
r152964.n: What if I want to walk with you?

t: Yes, it's a curious allod. And I like exploring it with my friend. We often wander in the desert, observing jinns and ifftie.
r152965.n: Do you and Alice ever go hiking?

t:
Her? No, never. Not even once.

But she's been hanging out with Phima Korolkin. He's the one that sends mail. To his mom, to his granny. Picks up parcels all the time. For all I know, he could be sending her letters as well.
r152972.n: Yes? I wonder if she's been sending packages.

r152973.n: Hello, do you have a minute to talk about Alice?

r152983.n: This isn't going the way I was thinking it should go. Let's start over.

t: Not at all. And I don't care about them. Why are you asking?
r152984.n: But she tells you her secrets, doesn't she?

t:
When I first met Alice, she was wearing pajamas... or a robe. I asked her if she was a pioneer. She said yes. I asked what happened to her uniform, and she told me she'd lost it.

So I picked up another uniform for her. They didn't find a pioneer set, so I took a school uniform. It looked good on her anyway.

But then I learned that Alice always picks up new uniforms! And never wears them! She just hands them over to her friends behind trash cans at the cafeteria.

Now I'm not sure that I did the right thing.
I have. But to tell you the truth, I regret it.
r152986.n: I know you've been helping Alice.

t: She should... I tried to ask her, but she said it was a big secret not for everyone.
r152987.n: I know her too. Do you think she has a secret?

r152988.n: You and Alice are such good friends, aren't you?

t:
If you go along with my plan, we'll know what's what.

For starters, it'd be nice to talk to everyone who had anything to do with her enrollment. Ask them what they know about her and how they met her.

You've already talked with Dynin and Nina. You can reach out to the following comrades:

First, Katya Rysina. She isn't in her troop, but Katya is keeping notes who left the camp and when. If Alice goes out, we'll know how often.

Second, it's Mister Postman Igor Pechkin. If Alice has been sending letters, he should know.

Third, it's Esenia Linen. She distributes uniforms. She can tell you who took one for Alice.

Fourth, it's Yana Cutlet. She hangs out by the cafeteria. She should know if Alice eats often.

Fifth, it's Maya Lamb. I know that Alice helped her. Find out what it was.

Sixth, our nurse, Viola de Ardeur. She gives everyone medical exams and takes everyone's weight. She should know if there's something wrong with Alice.

Seventh, it's Zina from the first troop. I'm sure she knows something! Aoidois have a nose for weird stuff.

Eighth, it's Sergey Russule. He's the mana tech club leader. The most suspicious thing is that Alice has joined the club! Besides, I know Sergey. He used to be a slacker and a buzzkill, and now he really got it together. It's strange.

Oh no, don't give me this look. Yes, it requires some running around! Do you want to know who Alice is or not?

Yes! I know for a fact that Alice isn't a pioneer.

I've been a librarian since my family had to quit the League a while ago. But never mind that!

I have my own black list of book thieves. I even blacklist friends of those who delayed a book, because who lives with cripples learns to limp. So pretty much every pioneer is in my list.

I know exactly who was going to Suslanger for this season. Alice wasn't one of them.

I even looked up passenger lists at the port ticket office. No Alice there.
Just take a good look! Does she look like a real pioneer to you? She's an impostor!

The redhead witch?

She should be in prison! Or in a loony bin!
r152997.n: The pioneer troop leader told me you might know something about Alice.

t:
I see. So we have a group of suspects. We will have to do some running around.

You ought to visit other comrades.

First, it's Phima Korolkin and Kolya Fomkin. They're obviously her sidekicks.

Second, her buddies Maas-Yulee, Lena Tihonova, Sarang Mika, and Ulyana Radziecka. I also think that Samantha might know something. Ask her.

Third, it's Russule. He says he's got a secret, hah. But I know what the matter is! Katya has seen him in town recently. I saw him at the camp at the same time! What a mystery. Two Russules! One of them might be an impostor. Find Russule in town and find out which one is real.
What is it? Go on, tell me.

I knew it! I knew it!

This Alice isn't a pioneer! Go to Dynin right now! Demand that he kick her out!

I knew it! It's all fraud.

Are you blind? Can't you see I'm a librarian?

When I first got to this beautiful camp, I thought there's be order. The League lacks order! We need to learn from the Empire. It was a disappointment. As messy as Irene's brothel!

What do you think I'm doing here? Looking after the local library. It's a nightmare if you ask me. Every book must be returned on time, let alone returned in a proper condition!

Do you think anyone at this camp follows these simple rules? At all? No!

So I had to close down the library.
The library is closed for renovations. I don't lend books at the moment.
r153014.n: The library is closed for renovations. I don't lend books at the moment.

r153016.n: Where were we... All right, let's start from the beginning.

t: She sleeps, eats, read books. You're such a big guy, how come you don't understand?
r153017.n: Not a bit. But I need to know what Alice does in your cabin.

t:
Excellent! I'll tell Alice that you want to join the brotherhood of the thingamajig keepers!

We'll beat the pirates together!

We only need to find the other pirate.
r153018.n: I might be able to help with the storage.

t: Hah. In fact, they're looking for something she doesn't have. She gave it to other pioneers to store. They're taking turns hiding it.
r153019.n: That's right. Good point. I'm scared of the pirates too.

t: You don't believe me? Just because I'm little, I don't understand anything? I wish my brothers were here. They'd make you forget how to hurt a little girl.
r153020.n: Hahaha, what pirate are you talking about? It's Skulnar the Fierce, the Horde Warchief.

t:
Woah, for real?

You know... you're right. See that fat orc over there with Nina? In fact, he's an astral pirate. Skulnar the Fierce! He wants to capture her. That's what she told me. This pirate has a sidekick, who could look like anyone. They're camouflaging! How cunning!
r153021.n: I think Alice is in danger.

r153022.n: I know that you have a roommate called Alice.

t:
I'm Ulyana Radziecka. Gibberling were very happy to visit this camp too!

It's so fun and there are so many people! Of course, it gets a little boring over time but we have so many friends! Together we invent mischief, so it's alright.

This and that. Many things. We swim, we hike, we prank! Comrade Dynin, the superintendent, is so funny when he gets angry for what we've done! He can't actually kick anyone out. You see, this allod is closed!

Goblinball and other sports are my favorite. Some day, I'm gonna win all golden medals at the Dionic Games.

r153027.n: Nah, that's a waste of time. Start over.

t:
That was rude. You don't understand. I was in a coffin for so many years, it's so boring... I didn't feel a thing, but just think of all the things that I missed. Other races didn't waste time, they came up with so many fascinating things! Let's take elves, for example. A lot of my fellow citizens hate elves, but I like them. Not as grim, very fun and always inventing something. They didn't really like us before. It's understandable. When you dig up from the grave, you don't look very pleasant. But now they don't mind us. Especially since we're covering our imperfections. It's not that difficult to be friends with elves. I'm so happy there's no more war! I never wanted it, in the first place. War and music don't have anything in common. Just picture me with a guitar, dashing forward to attack an enemy. It's ridiculous. It's a nightmare.

…

Are you even listening?
r153029.n: Cut it, you're talking too much.

t:
I'm sure you are.

It would be great to know what Alice likes. If she has a secret, it might also be her main interest. We need to find out somehow... But how? Slavyana might know. She should know. I'll just go and ask her about Alice's thing. I saw them talking about it once but I only had music in my head and didn't care to listen! I should figure out what she's hiding and make her a good gift.

…

Are you even listening?

Alice? Hiding? Never heard of it. Ooh! I know! She wants to surprise me and is hiding a gift! What do you think this is? I would love a new mana guitar. Should I tell her? Or not? If she's prepared something... it might ruin it. But I really really really want a good mana guitar. The old one's all shabby. If Alice knew, she would totally get me a new one! She's so kind and generous. Everyone brings her these useless green crystals, and she exchanges them for really great gifts! I've seen it with my own eyes. Perhaps, we should get her something too. I must decide what. She's so versatile, it's a rough choice. Music? Sports? Science? I think I should ask her very carefully...

…

Are you even listening?
r153031.n: I need to figure out what Alice is hiding.

t:
You should talk to Ulyana Radziecka. She's Alice's roommate.

I haven't been following her. Sorry.
r153038.n: You might have noticed strange things in her behavior.

t:
Alice?

Not much. She's an ordinary girl, very restless. The first troop is well-disciplined. However, the third troop is a noisy lot. So is Alice.
r153039.n: Hi! Can you tell me something about Alice?

t:
I might be wrong but it could be Lena Tihonova.

That's right! We were out of standard pioneer uniform, and I had to give her the school pack.
r153045.n: You might remember who it was that asked you to give it to her for the first time?

t: Let me see... She's got several packs already! I don't know how but she manages to tear it! Like, all the time! I already gave her the whole summer stock.
r153046.n: Hello! Can you tell me who asked you to give Alice the uniform?

t: Of course. It isn't given out for free, though.

Hi!

I'm responsible for keeping all pioneers' clothes tidy. I wash, dry, and iron. I can also give you a uniform.
r153049.n: Hi! I'm responsible for keeping all pioneers' clothes tidy. I wash,…

t:
Nah, I wouldn't say so. She's a talker alright. A real life of the party.

They've talked with Sarang Mika just recently. She is unlike other undead. She really likes to talk.
Alice steals chops to feed the orc announcer, but shh... it's for your ears only!
r153068.n: Is there anyone that she prefers?

t:
Alice? Is that the one in the school uniform? The redhead?

She talks all the time! One person or another!
r153069.n: Hello! You're always hanging around near the cafeteria. Did you see Alice talking to…

t: Gerasim is a fine example of the imperial teaching system success! Even an ogre can be a normal member of society! Would you like to have a friend like him?
Hello! I'm a cafeteria janitor. Sadly, food can be left over. And then Gerasim comes to rescue.
r153072.n: Hello! I'm a cafeteria janitor. Sadly, food can be left over. And then…

t:
This is what happened. I lost Hum Ham. He went out and simply disappeared. I was looking everywhere! In the camp and outside, and he was nowhere to be seen.

Alice offered help. She called Maas-Yulee for help, and the two of them found Hum Ham. He was chasing wild hares and ran away behind the cliff, where the portal used to be.

I'm so grateful to Alice! Especially because she's looking after my pets when I'm gone. Animals love her, you know?
Hello! That's right. She helped me a lot.
r153077.n: Hello! Eugenie told me that Alice was helping you.

t: Of course. We have a cute jerboa, who can play a horn.
r153079.n: I would like to see the animals.

t:
Good afternoon, comrade!

I'm in charge of the zoo.
r153080.n: Good afternoon, comrade! I'm in charge of the zoo.

t:
Isn't this out of the ordinary, pioneer?

By the way, when am I going to see you in my exam room? Remember, Comrade Dynin won't be happy if you bring a disease. We have company. Have you seen Samantha? She is a messenger of good will, the elf ruler's niece. I would hate it if something happened to her.

You have to hurry.
r153095.n: This... is very interesting! But was there anything out of the ordinary?

t:
Oh, pioneer.

She's fine. Excellent health, outstanding physical body, complete absence of flaws... Everyone should be like her.

It was curious to examine her. Medically speaking.
r153096.n: There might be something wrong with her.

t:
Alice? She's funny.

What do you want to hear, pioneer?
r153097.n: I'd like to ask you about Alice.

t: Priestess of the Church of Light She's the doctor and a nurse here.

r153127.n: I'm not sure you understood me. Let's go over it again.

t:
No! Alice is hundred percent honest! I trust her!

I have absolutely no reason to trust you!

Really? Really-really?

If it's the truth, I can tell you, I guess. Alice wanted me to hide something. I don't know what it is, but it's very valuable.

I have no idea where it is now. Only Alice knows that, I guess.
r153131.n: Kolya, I want to help Alice.

t:
No! She's incapable of using people.

She's willing to help everyone! And she has, many times! She's here to save us all. I don't really understand, from what... But it doesn't matter. We all trust Alice.
r153132.n: Kolya, Alice is only using you.

t: Me? Perhaps. But it's not my secret to reveal. Sorry.
r153142.n: Do you know anything about it?

t:
Alice is a unique mechanic, who can repair anything.

She is better trained than any specialist of ZIT Headquarters.

She's full of surprises. Many things she talks about now exist only as concepts that might be implemented some day in the future.

Alice?

She's surprisingly knowledgeable. She knows even more than I do.
r153144.n: Hello! Why did Alice sign up for the mana tech club?

t: The most important question for me right now is this: what does it mean to be a true person? I'm looking for an answer. So far unsuccessfully.
I would like to know an answer to this myself...
But you're a person. You're brave and strong, you can be the master of your destiny.
r153147.n: But you're a person. You're brave and strong, you can be the master of…

t: I took the first place in running, mathematics, and chess competitions. But I'm afraid I still haven't found an answer to the question that bothers me.
Hi, I'm Sergey from the third pioneer group. It's nice to meet you!
Childhood will be over eventually, it doesn't last forever.
r153150.n: Childhood will be over eventually, it doesn't last forever.

r153152.n: You lost me. Let's start over.

t:
Really? Great! You were asking about Alice.

I know how she arrived. I've been in town the whole time. I've seen everything.

The first time Alice came here in a trolley. Right after the ambrosia explosion. She might be connected with it.

She ran about, looked around, and left for the desert.

The second time was with you by manamobile. She hid behind a corner, took off her clothes, and changed into a hoodie that was there on the rope.

Then Lena brought her a school uniform from the camp. That's how she got into the camp. She simply returned in the evening with the others.

I don't think she's a pioneer. She's looking for something.
r153154.n: I'll talk to the scientist and settle it down.

t:
Really?

Then I'm going to tell you what the problem is.

I was one of the pioneers. Eventually, I got sick of the camp routines, lineups, and workouts. It's all the same every day.

So I decided to take a walk in the town. I was wandering around the town, visiting locals, peeking here and there. And then I met the scientist. He was crafting something. I took a closer look and found out that it was a mechanoid with all kinds of gears sticking out of him. Not as they show you in the newspapers, no. He was just like a real human!

The scientist noticed me and was, like, "Oh, young man, you're the one I need. Do you want to be part of my experiment?"

And I was, "What's the experiment, Pops?"

And he said that he was crafting a mechanoid that can't be told apart from a person. Apparently, he wanted to give him my appearance. The mechanoid could replace me in the camp, and no one would tell!

I can't tell you how happy I was! I thought the mechanoid would work for me, and I'd only have fun.

But yes, it happened exactly as the scientist promised. The mechanoid completely replaced me. I'm sick of having fun and hanging around but I simply can't return. It'll be a scandal.
r153155.n: I think I know who can help you.

t: No one can help me. Why did I even agree... I thought it was for the best. It turned out, nobody needed me.

Who? Ah, Sergey Russule! Let me think...

I know what to do! I got completely carried away with ethnography. Started gathering old folk tales, legends, and toasts. I had to ride a camel! There was no other transport.

And then I met her...

What was her name...

Lida... Zina... Oh, right. Nina. She's a local pioneer leader. We had such a lovely conversation.

She won't mind helping us. Tell her everything as it is, and ask her to help Russule. Give her my regards.
r153181.n: What is the real boy supposed to do?

t:
He couldn't keep it together and spilled the beans!

The experiment was unique! A real field test. Just as Yaver Turing suggested. If no one can tell the AI from a real boy, then it is truly alive.

I guess, it was a success. No one could tell them apart, you say? Yuppie! It's time for a doctorate!
r153182.n: I know everything about the mechanical pioneer.

t: There were only our four groups at the site. So it must be one of them. Who could it be? My people are out. Zem? Unlikely. I've known Negus Kheket for a while, none of them need it. The elves? It's possible, but I'm not sure what their motives would be. It's unlike them to sabotage their own work... And Herbert was so enthusiastic. There's one possibility: this Zarida with Catherina backing her. Catherina also wants to build a portal to another world, possibly using her Eclipse. That's why the Chronophone was stolen
r153184.n: What do you think caused it?

t:
The incident? I'm sure it was sabotage...

I haven't told anyone about this, but before we ran... I mean, evacuated from the site, I noticed that an important part was missing... The Chronophone! What is a Chronophone? Well, the thing that makes traveling through time and space possible! It influences the strings that comprise reality!

The Chronophone was stolen, I'm certain of it. Perhaps that's what caused the eruption... But it's possible the eruption happened before it was stolen...
r153185.n: Greetings! I was sent here to learn more about the incident...

t:
It's strange that you've never heard of me... I've worked on one of the Gates projects before. Without false modesty, I admit that the creator of the Gates-2 and Gates-3 largely used my work as a basis.

The last few years weren't kind to me. The launch of the Gates-2 was even worse... To begin with, we teleported the Great Mage Zayan from the past, which almost caused our entire timeline to collapse! And then... we decided to prevent Tep's Plague... But made a mistake in calculations and teleported it here. So Gates-2 are currently in quarantine, and I've been answering very awkward questions at the Committee for years.

And only when the construction of Gates-3 was underway, I was allowed to come here, to Suslanger... And now we have problems again!
r153186.n: Remind me again - who are you?

t:
I'm fairly certain it's the Zem. Every other one is a Tep Cultist! Even though Tep is dead, his minions are still alive and kicking. The Empire has always had issues with the Arisen - they keep running into maniacs and cultists.

What happened in Laboratory-9? In the White One-17? And in the Area 51? And of course, the very first Gates and Negus Jeeg who went insane! So I believe one of Negus Kheket engineers had a hand in this.
r153191.n: Who do you think is involved in that?

t:
Oh, it was terrifying! An explosion, screams, calls for help. Fortunately, we managed to get away before everything was covered with that... Ambrosia. My thoughts on what happened?

The eruption happened at the site, but we had nothing to do with it... It was something else...
r153199.n: Greetings! I was sent here to learn more about the incident...

t: Hmm, I'm the head of the elven engineers who arrived here at Aidenus and Catherina's request. The Gates-3 project is the child of both the League and the Empire, their attempt at reaching other worlds and spaces... The Great Ball is over, the Galleon Castle is complete - that's why we agreed to work here... Alas, not all differences can be overcome! Instead of working, we are forced to fill in hundreds of forms and questionnaires from the Xadaganian bureaucrats.
r153200.n: Remind me again - who are you?

t:
I have no proof, but I suspect the elves are to blame. They have no concept of discipline, focused as they are on their fantasies.

I personally had to veto a dozen ideas that Herbert's group showered us with. They want to improve this, upgrade that. Even though the project was approved in advance, and we had to follow the plan!

It's possible one of their "improvers" messed something up.
r153205.n: What do you think caused it?

t:
Greetings.

It is not possible to establish the causes without analyzing the readings of the equipment during the incident. Extrapolation suggests that sabotage took place. Or a criminal disregard for safety regulations.

Interviewing my staff allowed me to reconstruct a rough sequence of the events. Everything happened the day before the test launch of the Gates. Sufficient energy was accumulated, preparations were underway for the first launch...

However, the Gates were opened before we were ready. With high probability: the Ambrosia is the result of the release of energy from the other side.
r153206.n: Greetings! I was sent here to learn more about the incident...

t:
Negus Kheket, the Head Scientist of the Arisen. In the absence of the chairman of the Scientific Councils of Nefer Ur, I'm handling the affairs of the Arisen in the capital of the Empire. Currently serving as the leader of the Arisen research group on the Gates-3 project.

I'm not sure how reasonable it was to entrust the creation of the Gates to various groups that had not previously worked together, but the leaders of the Empire insisted on it.
r153207.n: Remind me again - who are you?

t: Greetings on behalf of all Zem people!
r153208.n: Greetings on behalf of all Zem people!

t: An attack! We... I mean, they! They want to attack... I mean, they want to capture the whole city! There is no water, we don't want to die, and there's so much stuff in the city... Hey, keep your hands off! Someone might have use for me...
Keep away! I don't want to end up like them!
r153317.n: Keep away! I don't want to end up like them!

t:
Alice, you say? She's the mysterious guest from the past?

Well... You know, I see "Daddy's" hand in this, but I'm not sure what he's playing at. Where's the demonic invasion? Who is this girl that's not even trying to hide? None of this makes sense.

At any rate, she slowed us down. No, she didn't stop us, just slowed our progress. This Chronophone she stole is a very complex device. It took us months to build it. I'm afraid we don't have that much time now. But what do we do? Catch the girl and shake her until she gives up everything she knows?

She could have hidden the device. And if she's one of Nihaz's creatures, you could cut her up and she still wouldn't say a thing. Damnation! What do we do?

Fine, fine. You wanted to wriggle into her favor? Let's play this game. Try asking her delicately - though I know it's not your forte - where the device could be. Nihaz loves games, so we'll play along. We've outplayed him before, right?
r153321.n: Yes, here's what I've learned... And it turns out Alice might be the one we're looking…

t:
Darn it! Who the hell is this Alice?

I have no idea! I swear!

You might have noticed that she's very much like me. But I'll be damned if I know who she is and where she came from. I suppose, it's just another of Nihaz's tricks. He has a sick 'sensahuma.'

You and I both know one thing: she's clearly lying, trying to buy time. I'm almost completely sure that it was Alice who stole the chronophone. It should be at the pioneer camp.

What choice do we have? All we can do is enter the game. Just like back at the Holy Land where we were looking for Sparks. Well... rather, you were looking for Sparks, and I was rooting for you.

Pioneers accept anyone in their ranks nowadays. It doesn't matter whether you're young or old, belong to the League or the Empire. Such is the time we live in. I don't expect any difficulties for you and Skulnar to blend in. And after you do... there's no mystery that can't be solved by the greatest hero of Sarnaut and the best mystic orc, also known as the chief of the Horde. Research, dig up every tiny detail of Alice's life and history, and find that chronophone!

I've already made an appointment with the superintendent. Get to the Dune right away.

Alice's story is over.

I'll try something else. There's always hope. Actually, hope is everything we have.

Fine.

Try to convince me from your time that I'm telling the truth. It's time to say goodbye now.

That's too bad!

But you'll have to learn that I was right. It's time to say goodbye now.
Do you believe me or not?

Yes.

If you disobey me, and I know you will, Sarnaut is doomed. Not the Darkness, but Life itself will become its tombstone. Can I change what's happened to me?

Who am I? Must I exist in your timeline? I'm just an anomaly, neither dead nor alive, stuck between existence and non-existence. By changing the past, I'm deleting myself. I don't have the divine immortality any longer. Any death would be final. I've torn the thread of my fate.

Only one issue remains.

Hah, we're getting closer. I can't change my own future. But I can change YOURS.

Trust me, the future that awaits you... I wouldn't want it for anyone. Anyone, you hear me?

You must not open the Gates! You must not search for my mother! And most importantly, you must not trust my sister!
r153337.n: What? Why did you even... why did you have to steal the chronophone?

t:
Still don't believe me?  I remember ordering you to find out who Alice was. I didn't know or realize it back then.

Trust me, a lot is going to happen before I become Alice.

How ignorant can you be? You've had the reply right in front of your eyes the whole time.

I'm Klavdia! Her Reincarnation, to be exact. From the future. The present-me has no idea that I'm about to create another Reincarnation.

I'm not too observant. Even I couldn't tell that me was me.
Yes, we need to make things right. I postponed it for as long as I could.
So she hasn't believed me, after all. Haha! Even if I had that heart, I would never give it to Erfar.
r153341.n: So she hasn't believed me, after all. Haha! Even if I had that heart,…

t: So we have a deal? Don't you try to deceive me. Words have a great meaning where there's a great power behind them.

Huh, another deal! Life truly consists of black and white. Although I'm somewhere in the middle.

It doesn't matter though. I can help you with finding Alice. All I need in exchange is your word. A promise. A partnership agreement, as the Free Traders put it.

Deal?
r153348.n: I need to find Alice. On what conditions?

t:
Alice? Alice, Alice... Alice here, Alice there. Everybody needs an Alice. I wonder why. No one wonders what the poor girl needs.

And I did. And I have the answer. I think I can help. Not for free, of course. This isn't charity.

So our deal is simple. She wanted to get away. Erfar and I wanted the heart of a dragon. You see, thanks to the dragon blood that I got from Nezeb, I was immortal. But his descendants forgot our agreement. Erfar needs the heart to return to the living. Alice promised to get it.

Sounds fair. I completed my part of the deal... unlike her.
r153349.n: What are you doing here? And where's Alice?

t:
A couple of things.

My spies noticed strange activity under the surface of this Allod. These caves belonged to Wormfaces. Their network is still working. Obviously, they're gathering power. The Star Gates in the Dead City are a valuable prize.

Now you have the Gates of your own. They're wanted by all those who want to leave Sarnaut. Watch out, though. The enemy won't give you margin for error if you use them.
r153350.n: Anything else that I need to know?

t:
That's right. Sarn's trap has shut. But our Emperor is still in Sarnaut. I know that you saved his Spark from Tep's Pyramid. Then you met him on Eclipse. Nezeb dwells in the deep layers of the Astral.

Amazed by my knowledge? Now you see that you'd better respect our agreement. I know many things. I have eyes and ears everywhere.

You will help me bring it back. How? I don't know. Yet.
r153351.n: But Nezeb died at the false June Gates.

t:
I give him information and support in exchange for the immortality. You already know about the Great Mages' Ambassadors. Those who aren't mages but who had dragon blood. You're one of them, but as you know, the power is limited. It has to be refilled. That's why I need dragon blood.

Alas, my source has disappeared together with Nezeb. Yasker wouldn't deal with me. Biiiig mistake. He could have done so much more with me. He's drowning in a sea of petty things he's unable to figure out.

Only the return of Nezeb can save the Empire.
r153352.n: Tell me about your agreement with Nezeb.

t:
Look around. This is the Court of Miracles.

Each allod has one. Have you ever seen a beggar? All of them are working for me. They're physically healthy, only pretending to be sick and injured. As they return to their shelters, their injuries disappear by magic. Hence the Court of Miracles.

Although mine is truly mind-blowing.

As to the Brotherhood... I've always needed someone to guard the ruins and Nezeb's treasures in the sands. Exiles, outcasts, and rebels are a perfect fit. They've been serving me for centuries, thinking that they're rebelling against authorities.
r153353.n: What are the Court of Miracles and the Brotherhood of the Last Shelter?

t: You've got the right to hear the answers.
Of course, they have. Every valuable thing eventually lands in the hands of the Brotherhood. Here. Make sure you don't lose it again! How did you even pull it off?
r153355.n: Have your servants brought you the chronophone? I can't find it anywhere.

t: Why the long face? Did you expect to see someone else here?
r153356.n: Why the long face? Did you expect to see someone else here?

t: The sun is scorching. You need to hurry.
r153359.n: The sun is scorching. You need to hurry.

t: My dear young friend, fire of my life, juice of my apple! Your wish is music to my ears, like muezzin's call in the Old Town. Beware! Such power attracts unwanted attention! While you have this blessing on you, you will be attacked by jinns and defenders of the Court of Miracles!
r153362.n: Please, grant me the ability to see tracks on the sand.

t: Pit of my peaches, water of my river! You're asking the old jinn the right question! I do not know where the chronophone is. Even I can't know that. But finding the girl named Alice is in my power. I will give you the eyes of the wind, the eyes of the desert! You will see all that you need to see! Follow the footsteps of your friend. The first tracks are right here. She was visiting the old man, too. I wish I could have helped her.
r153363.n: Wise jinn, if you could kindly tell me where to find the girl Alice with the intricate…

t:
Oh, my young friend! The extension of my fingers, the strength of my wrists!

Today is an unusual day for all jinns! On days like this, signified by the position of the true moon, sun, and stars, the jinns go on a pilgrimage to their ancient kingdom! They are reminiscing about the past...

On these days, the shelters are left without their guards. Of course, the evil Ifrits do not honor their traditions, which is why they will pose a threat to you and your companions.

Fortunately, you can find protection from their wrath in those treasures their minions are guarding! These gifts of the jinns will help you hide from the wrath of the wicked!
r153370.n: Tell me about the Exodus of Jinns

t:
Oh, my young friend! The strength of my back, the wellbeing of my belly!

To our people, you are all the same... Your squabbles are not our concern. We help all the inhabitants of the desert, because we sense that you will need treasures to fight the approaching darkness...

But as far as I understand, these orcs in the scrapyard were divided into two groups... One is called the Warriors, the others are the Raiders. Some obey the fierce warrior in black, the others revere the mighty warrior famous for his survival skills...

Jinns will help both!

Once these Raiders had no idea how to survive in the Storm... But they have learned a bit of wisdom - they know how to use shelters, and they know they need to look for chests. They are loading them onto their... cars. Of course, you could fight them for their chests before they take them to their camp... Otherwise, those treasures will be lost to you - they will belong to the Raiders.
r153371.n: The Landfill Raiders are roaming the desert now?

t:
My young friend, the joy of my heart! Allow me to tell you about the mysteries of this desert!

Great Nezeb, may his name be blessed, hid countless treasures in these sands. They have been hidden for centuries, but the Storm that came to these lands started uncovering ancient caches.

Every couple of hours, the wind grows stronger... First it reveals the smallest of Nezeb's chests, then large ones, and in the end, the Great Treasure - the biggest of them all!

But don't think they will be easy to get, my young friend! The treasures are protected by Ifrits' magic, and to open them, you will need the power of the creatures that guard them. With each opened treasure, your Greed grows, and the greater it is, the more treasures you will find in the last chest.

Be careful! During a Storm, it's easy to die and lose all the collected keys to treasures, along with a part of the accumulated Greed. Most of the dangers can be avoided, but beware of the Wrath of Ifrits - only my brothers can protect you from it in their shelters. If you don't make it to a shelter before the Wrath of Ifrits falls upon you, you will die!

Oh, my young friend, the joy of my heart!

I need your help again - I need an ancient artifact that would help me get rid of the Fire Ifrits and their ruler! It's an ancient copper lamp enchanted with Nezeb's spells! Its fragments are scattered all over the desert...

There are three ways to get them:

First method: the fragments in the sands will occasionally appear during strong magical disturbances, like the Wrath of Ifrits... But they appear shortly before it peaks!

Second method: other fragments were devoured by Uro-Boros - the only creature in the deserts whose stomach is strong enough for that! Defeat it, and you'll get the fragments!

Third method: some of the fragments were discovered by the Ifrits. They locked them in their chests... They guard those chests - and they are only visible during a Storm!

If you collect the fragments of the ancient lamp, I will reward you. You will receive the armor that contains the most formidable of my brethren - Devona.
r153375.n: There are rumors you're looking for lamp fragments...

t:
Oh, my young friend, oil for my hair, comb for my beard!

I know the gifts you need to find, but only a small part of me will go with you to guide you. The sand will tell you where to look when you are there. But you will have to be thorough!

Are you ready to set out?
Thank you, my friend. Jinns could use the Storm Essence, and you will need Ambrosia.
r153382.n: Exchange Faded Storm Essence ({sourceCount} pcs) for Ambrosia ({destinationCount} pcs)

t: Oh, my dear friend, the quartz of my sand, the breeze of my coast - you no longer need the essence of the Storm. You won't be able to get it from Nezeb's Treasure and you won't be able to use it to buy goods on Suslanger. But I'll gladly trade it for Ambrosia if you still have any left...

You have too much Ambrosia, my friend. I'm trading one Storm Essence for two hundred Ambrosia particles, and your purse is almost full and can't hold them.

Come back to me when you've spent some Ambrosia.
r153384.n: You have too much Ambrosia, my friend. I'm trading one Storm Essence…

t: I haven't seen these sands for centuries... Everything has changed.
r153385.n: I haven't seen these sands for centuries... Everything has changed.

t: You can't rely on miracles these days, you have to be the captain of your destiny!
r153394.n: You can't rely on miracles these days, you have to be the captain of…

t:
What do you think? Let's go see Fury the Merciless!

Me showing up with you should at least be puzzling for the orcs, so hopefully they won't attack right away.

Act calmly. Just keep walking and speak when spoken to.

Are we going?
I've been waiting for a while.
r153400.n: I've been waiting for a while.

t:
Well, damn it. I understand, there is so much going on!

Look, you can't go there alone, you'll be jumped immediately... But fine, I'll take you! Let's go?
Ohh, wait. You're the bane of worms! It's thanks to you that my brother came back alive! Wow. Respect!
r153405.n: We need to talk to Fury...

t: Any heat is bearable when you have a job to do!
r153479.n: Any heat is bearable when you have a job to do!

t: Oh, they got me good... We shouldn't have provoked them...
r153480.n: Oh, they got me good... We shouldn't have provoked them...

t: Excellent. Now go speak with Eladia and get down to work!

Eladia and I gave it a thought, and I think we found something!

There's a way to configure the portals so that the teleports on Suslanger will be focused on you - meaning, it won't be you teleporting to the teleportation device, but the device itself will be teleporting you to it. Sound complicated, doesn't it?

Yes, quite. And what's most important: this method consumes a lot of energy - more than the mana conduit in Nezebgrad consumes in a month! Fortunately, we have energy - we stored it for the Gates-3. We'll have to spend it all on you... So please find out everything quickly.

At least we don't need to let anyone off the allod before we solve all our problems and get Yasker's permission!
r153522.n: Are there no other ways to travel here?

t:
Alas, we know very little at the moment. The Incident occurred in the evening when most of the scientists were finishing their work. We have witnesses, but there are few of them.

They have all been evacuated from the site where the project was constructed... And they are here in the city.

Alas, this event is not the only problem on our allod. But others can wait. Now we need to deal with our teleportation problems, so you don't get trapped again.
r153523.n: What do we know so far?

t:
As you already know, an Incident took place on our allod. It disrupted communications with other allods... An astral storm of unknown strength and origin, and it doesn't look like it's going to abate.

The Gates are the cause, of course... It's not the first time it has happened, alas... but this project is too important to abandon.

We suspect it might be sabotage. Gates-3 were ready for a test launch, they were accumulating energy for a test run... And suddenly this happens!

You need to find out what exactly happened and caused the Incident.
Of course! She presented you as someone who can solve our numerous problems. I can't have you hear about these problems from third parties.
r153525.n: I'm sorry I'm late... Eladia said you wanted to speak with me?

t:
We'll do everything quickly and efficiently!

Most of all, I'm confused by the fact that they have more Orc Scouts in their ranks now...

But they are Orcs, not cunning Elves... Go to the nearest Raider squad - at the dune, near the plantations - and thrash them until they are shaking in their shoes!

These scouts will surrender, but they will only tell the truth if they are truly scared...

Once the desired effect has been achieved, find the scout, smack him a few times, then interrogate him.

I'm afraid she's right. The Orc Raiders seem to have lost all senses, and Fury the Merciless is no authority for them. We had to endure the attacks of these madmen before, but recently they started approaching the city walls.
 Slowly but surely gaining momentum. I know they are planning something, but I want to know the details.
r153527.n: Eladia says the problem with the orcs has gotten worse...

t:
Sounds dubious.

But! This is still a way to settle the matter peacefully.

Head towards the entrance to their camp I'll inform Eladia. You'll meet there. We can't waste even a minute.
r153528.n: Perhaps we should try speaking with Fury... She's not as radical.

t:
It's interesting... That is, these Raiders do not obey anyone, and our sabotage only incited them further. The situation is worse than I thought.

No one will send any reinforcements, we have more generals than soldiers in the city, and the portal is barely working. And our city is not that easy to defend...

Perhaps you have an idea? You seem to have many wars under your belt!
r153529.n: Share what you saw at the Orc camp

t:
Deal a decisive blow!

...But I have doubts. People's lives are at stake, and success is not guaranteed. The orcs are not afraid to die, so they'll fight fiercely.

On the other hand, what options do we have? So let's find what the situation is over there...
r153530.n: What are we planning to do?

r153531.n: Teleport me to the Gates-III construction site

t: Hero of Sarnaut, I believe? It's nice to meet you!
r153532.n: Hero of Sarnaut, I believe? It's nice to meet you!

t:
As I said, all I need is to enter the Gates. You let me and Sturegga pass, we can keep you company until we reach your destination, and then we'll say our goodbyes. You can keep Skulnar.

Besides, our Draconids will help you defend the Gates from other races, trying to break out of Sarnaut.
r153680.n: She wants to hear about your terms.

t:
Quite well, thank you. Did I say, "quite well?" Absolutely perfect!

Too perfect, in fact. This world... how should I put it... is unusual. One thing you ought to remember: the Purgatory, Servants of Tensess, and the lay brother, they're all in Sarnaut. There are no such things here. Death here is permanent.

Thankfully, it's not that easy to die here. There was this knucklehead, stupid enough to reach out to grab something from under a running saw. Lost his arm in a second. I thought he was done with. You know what happened? He regrew a working limb! Over a week's time!

But that's not all! Then wild beasts came, and one of the guys lost his head.

You won't believe it either. He regrew the head! As good as new. Blank memory, of course, but it's nothing, really.

I had a cripple leg back on Sarnaut. It hurt like hell. It hurt so bad that I had to take psy-spice to kill the pain. Guess what? The pain is gone! I can run a thousand in this world!

We have to soak the Arisen in formaldehyde. Otherwise they risk becoming normal people, hehe. On the other hand, old wounds remain unchanged.

But don't worry, there are reliable ways to die even here. For example, if you're poisoned or ripped to pieces. We've lost a lot of our guys. Be careful with local creatures.
r153694.n: How are you doing in the strange new world?

t: Greetings. What seems to be the problem? Headache? Diarrhea? Shaky hands?
r153695.n: Greetings. What seems to be the problem? Headache? Diarrhea? Shaky…

t:
Uh, I don't even know what to say.

Do you know how I landed here? Of course, you don't. You know how many Great Tree specialists there are in Sarnaut? That's right, not so many.

When they ordered me to quit my job and go to Suslanger, I got upset. And the things that we're doing here, ugh...

This is the new world, absolutely unique, full of secrets to explore... but all we want is ambrosia.

We chop down trees, we pick up branches and leaves. We produce wood as well. Everything is crushed and pressed. We squeeze out juice and steam it. This is how we get concentrated ambrosia, much more powerful than the stuff from Suslanger.

Ambrosia. The blood of Great Trees...

I dreamed of knowing where it all began.

And now I'm having a hand in the destruction of this world...
r153713.n: How are you doing in the strange new world?

t:
Haha, I never expected to be here! But the pay is great, not to mention all the handsome males in uniforms! The military are the sexiest. And the most appealing of all is our commander Felix. All covered in scars... so manly!

They say it was Gorluxor who beat him, when Yasker and Felix were trying to trap the old Great Mage. But you know, they may be lying.

I had a fussier job before. I had so much "oooh" and "aaaah" during the day and so much bathhouse during the night...

This place is quiet for a change. I can talk to girls all I want or have as many tea breaks as I like. It's just these animals behind the wall. They're real scary.
r153757.n: How are you doing in the strange new world?

t:
Oh, nice.

Where did we last meet? On Irene? On Ammer? On Ferris?

No, I've never been on Irene.

This place is more fun. For the first time in my life I can have everything I want. There's no control of spare parts, you just grab what you want. We've got tons of them here. I can assemble any mechanoid to your liking! Oh, and there's ambrosia. Cool stuff. There's no limit to the power of my engines.

I don't think we're anywhere near discovering all its properties. We might be on the threshold of a great breakthrough!
r153762.n: How are you doing in the strange new world?

t: Congratulations on your first step along the Star Trail. As you know, this is a crowded place. Here we can see the consequences of one of the encounters.
r153784.n: Congratulations on your first step along the Star Trail. As you know,…

t: We reached all internal worlds. Everything as Nihaz predicted.
r153785.n: We reached all internal worlds. Everything as Nihaz predicted.

t: Um, let me see... ah, here it is.
Sure thing. Eladia gave me a special stone for that. Good stuff. What you got? Ah, never mind. Take care. Are you flying?
r153789.n: Can you return me to the Suslanger? Got one thing to deal with...

t: Ugh, last time the first leap took us to a different place. Come on, instinct, don't let me down! I don't want to wander forever!
r153790.n: Ugh, last time the first leap took us to a different place. Come on,…

t: It looks like there's been a great war on this Trail. It's way older than our world. Perhaps, even older than the rest of the worlds.
r153791.n: It looks like there's been a great war on this Trail. It's way older…

t: Yeah, I figured. You jump into the portal. I'll hang around a little longer. Talk later! It's just too beautiful.

Uh, you see, we wrote it in a way so only a Sarnaut dweller would understand. It mentions only the latest events, hah. The problem is that I wasn't an eye-witness, so I can't judge. I completely missed the Gods versus Fartitects fight. Here's what it says:

We learned the truth about the Light,

That Demons aren't Sarnaut's blight.

The God of Darkness got a new foe:

Threat under mountains and snow.

Walked along Nezeb's sandy path.

You're still here with us? You can reveal it, it's no high-school math.
r153795.n: Alright, what does this stone say...

t: Here's the thing... We have five crystals. They must be activated in the correct order to open the portal. We sealed it ourselves, hah. We even left an instruction! But I forgot the order anyway... Can you help?
Um... there's something wrong here. We should have put down the answers.
r153797.n: Um... there's something wrong here. We should have put down the answers.

t:
All that has been created will perish.

All that has perished will be recreated.

The existence is a great circle. There is no creation without destruction. There is no destruction without creation.

The circle has no beginning or end.

The divine couple has always existed. All-Mother and Father Time. I, All-Mother, is the goddess of life and creation. Father Time is the god of death and destruction. Together we led our worlds through the cycles of births and deaths. We created and destroyed.

We were not alone. Our passion gave birth to our divine children, subject to us. Each of them played their own role. Each of them obeyed the common laws. There were twelve Domains in my hierarchy. Each Domain was responsible for a single power. Each Domain had a master.

Only I, All-Mother, the goddess of creation, and my divine husband, Father Time, the god of destruction, were eternal Lords of our Domains. Other gods were immortal and lived very long lives, which ultimately had to be over. The circle has always spun, and gods were destined to die.

Many years have passed.
This flower of the Great Tree contains All-Mother's memories.
r154160.n: This flower of the Great Tree contains All-Mother's memories.

t:
This flower of the Great Tree contains All-Mother's memories.

But you are not ready to see them yet.
r154161.n: This flower of the Great Tree contains All-Mother's memories. But you…

t:
I am one of the hunters of our tribe.  I think you are wondering - "why does the tribe have hunters if they feed on Ambrosia."  But our task is a little different from foraging, although personally I have nothing against predators who kill to survive, because this is all part of the Great Cycle. And our animals are also full of Ambrosia, and if there is no other way, then we feed on them.

First of all, by virtue of our nature, we must maintain the balance. Sometimes, unreasonable beasts behave... unreasonably. In some places predators oppress herbivores, in others herbivores have become too prolific and have trampled down all the grass. It is important to maintain the balance.

This is especially true for large creatures like Treebors - ordinary predators won't be able to defeat those.

The important thing is that no life will be taken in vain, because their bodies will become humus, an important ingredient in soil. We start hunting only after performing all necessary rituals, with an understanding of our goal and the blessing of the All-Mother.
r154324.n: Hello, what do you do here?

t: Greetings! Remember, the forest can be dangerous...
r154325.n: Greetings! Remember, the forest can be dangerous...

t:
Your Spark might have something in common with this world and the element of Fire.

Among the dragons that arrived with Nihaz to Sarnaut, Sheratan would be the closest to you.
r154361.n: I feel that I have kindred to the world Pyro

t:
Pyro is the unfriendliest of the elemental worlds.

The god Pyro once was the guardian of the Forge of the Gods, where they created artifacts used to make other worlds. The enraged fire giant guarded his lands of deserts and lava lakes. Pyro was one of Nihaz's primary targets shortly after the Great War began. The Darkness came to Pyro and destroyed ancient cities, ravaged these lands, erased the only remaining life from it.

Nihaz destroyed Pyro and gained power of Fire. Time passed, and the Darkness was gone. Pyro began to come back to life. Survivors gathered in underground towns or high towers where the surface heat was not so burning.

The new goddess, Afeta, took place of the fallen deity. She knew the metalworking. She created masterpieces. I personally can't appreciate what's made of dead metal, but still.

Regardless of her skills, she failed to set life on good course in Pyro. The underground city and tower rulers took power in their hands. Their hearts were possessed by Nihaz's darkness. Their wars with each other and other elemental worlds led to numerous calamities.
r154362.n: I want to ask about Pyro, the world of Fire

t:
Your Spark might have something in common with this world and the element of Water.

Among the dragons that arrived with Nihaz to Sarnaut, Tegmin would be the closest to you.
r154363.n: I feel that I have kindred to the world Agva

t:
Agwa is one of the friendliest inner worlds.

Once it was nothing but a vast ocean with occasional archipelagos raising from water here and there. The world's vigilant patron was the great god Agwas, who kept an eye out for any and all troubles. However, his first and foremost priority has always been the ocean and its depth. He didn't pay much attention to the mortals on the archipelagos.

Alas, even a bottomless ocean could not protect the world of Agwa against Hirkalla's army of Darkness. In pursuit of the aquatic elemental power, she emptied the ocean and challenged Agwas to a fight. And one of the keepers of inner worlds perished...

Hirkalla left. The storm has abated. The great god Neyes has become the new patron of the world. Neyes was spending more time with mortals than his predecessor, and the Agwa's mortals got to worship him more.

Neyes is a battle-hardened warrior. His exuberant nature matches the temper of the stormy ocean but he is merry and brave, and he loves boisterous worlds and competitions. The archipelagos are thriving under his rule. There's no more civil warfare. Everybody is busy doing their own thing. For fun, mostly.
r154364.n: I want to ask about Agwa, the world of Water

t:
Your Spark might have something in common with this world and the element of Air.

Among the dragons that arrived with Nihaz to Sarnaut, Alsirr would be the closest to you.
r154365.n: I feel that I have kindred to the world Eira

t:
Elemental worlds suffered the most. They were sources of divine energy needed to create other worlds, so every party was hunting for them. Eira loved freedom too much to obey anyone.

However, Eira, the powerful leader, was one of the perished gods. Nihaz took part of her power that he later accumulated in the materialized Seal.

Eira was a furious goddess, the ruler of winds and hurricanes. She didn't care much of mortals' needs and lives. She found her tragic end in one of the battles. Ermay, cunning and slick, replaced her. Her former subordinate, he knew what his followers needed. Their number began to grow. He is the patron of merchants, crooks, and philosophers. Ermay is considered to lead Sparks along star tracks.
r154366.n: I want to ask about Eira, the world of Air

t:
Your Spark might have something in common with this world and the element of Earth.

Among the dragons that arrived with Nihaz to Sarnaut, Elnat would be the closest to you.
r154367.n: I feel that I have kindred to the world Erde

t:
Erde. An elemental world, a source of building materials for other worlds. The famous Horn of Abundance comes from here. It's always full of the great gifts of the Earth. It was once ruled by the horned god Erd, the keeper of the treasures, who watched his lands and couldn't tolerate intruders. The Great War knows no pity. The harsh xenophobic god perished in a battle with the Darkness.

He was replaced by Theona, a young goddess of Gardens and Groves, a younger sister of Hirkalla and Hinanna. She wanted to make the suffering world beautiful again. She covered it with fruit trees, abundant meadows, and green fields. Unlike Eden, full of pristine forests, Erde is a farmland, cultivated by hardworking people. However, there are people, marked by Nihaz. They want to explode the ground and mind minerals and gems, like in the old days. Erde is a safe world but not ideally safe.
r154368.n: I want to ask about Erde, the world of Earth

t:
Your Spark might have something in common with this world and the element of Order.

Among the dragons that arrived with Nihaz to Sarnaut, Sirma would be the closest to you.
r154369.n: I feel that I have kindred to the world Inis

t:
Don't expect any hospitality from Inis if you ever make it there. Its dwellers are harsh and quick to judge. Their trial is just but not exactly merciful.

There's a reason for the harshness. None of the inner worlds suffered as much as Inis. This stronghold of Order lost its god Juvius, who fell victim to Nihaz.

After Juvius perished, Inis suffered a lot of invasions. At first, Hirkalla's Dark army set foot in these lands. Then Amaya brought her creatures of Chaos to these lands. And finally, Inis was ravaged by legions of architects, enforcing their own vision of Order.

The influence of an egregore as powerful as the Architect sapped the strength of Inis. However, the world hasn't lost heart. Young Nemia, the new goddess, took over the domain of Order.

She turned to the outer worlds. Her ambassadors started recruiting an army for the upcoming war. Thanks to her iron willpower, the world got their own legion that counterattacked the enemy. Eton, the got of Light, allied with Nemia, and their armies fought together.

The Architect perished. He shattered into million shards, and the strength of the goddess of Order has grown exponentially. Now Nemia heads the army that successfully opposes Nihaz and his servants, destroying the blight of Chaos in the outer worlds. However, this war is far from being won.

Inis today is a military bastion, whose whole life yields to strict army regulations. The most popular punishment is death sentence. The life is regulated by a comprehensive Military Code.
r154370.n: I want to ask about Inis, the world of Order

t:
Your Spark might have something in common with this world and the element of Light.

Among the dragons that arrived with Nihaz to Sarnaut, Regul would be the closest to you.
r154371.n: I feel that I have kindred to the world Enod

t:
Enod is the world of Light. Sarn's creation. His very triumph. There's no place for shadows in Enod. Its multiple Suns shine the light on the snow-white sky, and the golden cities of wise alvies lie beneath them.

But this world isn't as serene as ours. Enod existed long before Nihaz began his rebellion. The dark servants knew very well where it was. It's a challenge for every follower of the God of Darkness, and their effort to destroy this world is untold.

The worst part is that Sarn is gone. Enod has no patron anymore. Only four tetranonymous, his loyal followers, could gather an army large enough to defend the world. It was like that until the new God of Light, the glorious Eton, came to replace Sarn.

Now Eton and his loyal tetranonymous continue to fight Nihaz. They fought back his attacks, led by the evil Hirkalla, and began an onslaught, attacking their armies in many worlds.
r154372.n: I want to ask about Enod, the world of Light

t:
Your Spark might have something in common with this world and the element of Chaos.

Among the dragons that arrived with Nihaz to Sarnaut, Sargas would be the closest to you.
r154373.n: I feel that I have kindred to the world Sherk

t:
Sherk is the world of Chaos. A planet of diversity, with swamps, lava fields, and glaciers.

All kinds of monsters are always born here. Nihaz was the first to notice it. He wanted an army that would allow him to fight with Sarn and Juvius as equals.

He reached agreement with the numerous monsters surprisingly fast. It wasn't enough to bring them to his army. He needed something to teach them to act together. And that's where the Dark God failed. Chaos can't be harnessed. The eternal riot is the essence of it. Armies of Chaos fought with each other more often than with the army of All-Mother that were united and loyal to their leaders.

Of course, the creatures of Chaos were strong and capable of doing a lot of harm. The worst of them was the leader of the Chaos Domain, Sherk. He was a giant, sleeping on the ocean floor. Nihaz awakened him and sent him to assault one of the strongholds of the Order. It was a miracle when Juvius's armies repelled the powerful god, who inflicted madness only by his appearance on the battlefield.

Sherk gave in, and Nihaz dealt the fatal blow that took some of his power.

Sherk died, but his place was taken by someone else. Amaya, the treacherous goddess of Chaos, the ancestor of a fireskinned race, took advantage of the situation and gained control over Chaos. She had never trusted Nihaz. She realized that his goals were larger than anything that Chaos creations might ever want. Now that she began to act on her own, Nihaz became her enemy. That was the point when the Chaos began to fight for itself in this war.
r154374.n: I want to ask about Sherk, the world of Chaos

t:
Your Spark might have something in common with this world and the element of Darkness. Beware!

Among the dragons that arrived with Nihaz to Sarnaut, Zuben would be the closest to you.
r154375.n: I feel that I have kindred to the world Ossu

t:
Ossu is the world of Darkness. One might think that it's the center of Nihaz's power, the destruction of which would lead Enod and Inis to victory in the Great War.

But it would be tragically, dramatically wrong. Ossu is the dead world, empty, save for shadows. Everyone who gets here eventually gets sick. If I understand the Sage correctly, the disease is the same as Tep's plague. The only difference is that the dead Sparks don't gather in Pyramids. They get affected by the Darkness and become base for dark soul creations.

Nihaz has taken everything he ever wanted from Ossu. He doesn't want complete power over the Darkness, unlike the Forgotten. He wants something else.
r154376.n: I want to ask about Ossu, the world of Darkness

t:
Your Spark might have something in common with this world and the element of Creation.

Among the dragons that arrived with Nihaz to Sarnaut, Situla would be the closest to you.
r154377.n: I feel that I have kindred to the world Fiore

t:
Fiore is the source of life among the worlds. The world of creation was too valuable to be affected by war. Nihaz put a real effort to understand its mysteries but failed.

Abandoned by its goddess, Fiore gives birth to numerous new life forms, transferred then to new worlds.

It's amazingly peaceful, although its visitors told about unimaginable images that came to them. These are the Spinning Wheel, and the Wheel, and the Source of Sparks, and other mysteries.
r154378.n: I want to ask about Fiore, the world of Creation

t:
Your Spark might have something in common with this world and the element of Death.

Among the dragons that arrived with Nihaz to Sarnaut, Nashira would be the closest to you.
r154379.n: I feel that I have kindred to the world Eresh

t:
Eresh. The sinister world of Death. It hasn't always been like this. A long while ago it was the dreamy world that gave rest to those who were ready to be reborn in their own body. It gave the eternal peace to those, whose time has come to an end. It was possible thanks to the guardians of Ganzir and soul drivers. Everything changed when Eresh, the leader of guardians, gave in to Nihaz's pleads and faced All-Mother and Father Time. Hardly anyone was aware of the Dark God's cunning. He clashed Death Guards and Dragons of the Void. Then his promised daughter Hirkalla took Eresh's main weapon and symbol of power over his world, the Scythe of Death. Hirkalla slain the High Guardian of Death and took the throne that was promised to her. She ruled the bigger part of Eresh from the Palace of Ganzir. Only Shetius, a senior guard, refused to swear allegiance. He had way fewer followers.

Eresh has changed. Nihaz and Hirkalla abandoned their duty and used the Sparks, imprisoned there, for their dark purposes.

As a consequence, Eresh was no longer the final destination for the dead Sparks. Now they were scattered throughout the universe, each attracted to the most powerful center of attraction.
r154380.n: I want to ask about Eresh, the world of Death.

t:
Your Spark might have something in common with this world and the element of Destruction.

Among the dragons that arrived with Nihaz to Sarnaut, Rukbat would be the closest to you.
r154381.n: I feel that I have kindred to the world Dizz

t:
Dizz is the world of Destruction. Father Time's throne. Father Time's grave. The divine spouse of All-Mother fell from the hand of treacherous Nihaz, who took part of his power. Only god can kill a god. No one suspected that Time itself could be killed as well. Father was the end and beginning of the Great Circle. He kept the time bent into a circle. Every ending was also a beginning of something and each beginning ultimately led to an end. Now it's all different. The time broke the circle and went on into the Eternity. This is the straight line without an end.

Nihaz's victory meant something else. The dragons of the Void have witnessed the defeat of their Lord and sided with the God of Darkness.

These timeless mighty creatures were the essence of Destruction. They inhabited Dizz and nearby worlds, including the world of dragons, known as Servants of Nihaz. After the death of Time, they all were on his side.
r154382.n: I want to ask about Dizz, the world of Destruction

t:
Your Spark might have something in common with this world and the element of Life. You're just like us!

Among the dragons that arrived with Nihaz to Sarnaut, Revati would be the closest to you.
r154383.n: I feel that I have kindred to the world Eden
